name: seo-technical
tagline_zh: 网站被爬虫拒之门外？九项技术体检一次查清：抓取、索引、速度、结构化数据……连 IndexNow 都帮你测。
tagline_en: Crawlers blocked? One audit covers crawl, index, speed, schema, JS, and even IndexNow—so Google finally sees your.
desc_en: Technical SEO audit across 9 categories: crawlability, indexability, security, URL structure, mobile, Core Web Vitals, structured data, JavaScript rendering, and IndexNow protocol. Use when user says "technical SEO", "crawl issues", "robots.txt", "Core Web Vitals", "site speed", or "security headers".
why_zh: 同类工具只查表面，它连 JavaScript 渲染和 IndexNow 协议都测，九类问题一次定位。
why_en: Unlike shallow checkers, it digs into JS rendering and IndexNow, covering 9 technical areas in one pass—saves you hours of.
